deviations.what: Browser pass (t16a) found the sandbox is one shared #general with full history: a new guest sees earlier guests' nicks, questions and flagged content. Owner decided: each guest gets a private room with sbx-ask (guests never see each other; owner sees all rooms from Guest view), and system join/welcome lines are hidden in guest and Guest-view sessions. Same pass also fixes: GET /login 404 after Access SSO, chat log opening at the oldest message, empty sandbox member list, false 'agent offline' in the owner's Guest view, htmx CSP errors (keyup filters + inline indicator styles), missing username field on the password form, token mail copy

deviations.what: Pre-PR must-fix set from the post-browser-pass triage: (1) guest deletion also purges the guest's messages from the sandbox IRCd history and sbx-ask's flag log; guest rooms get a random per-guest id (#g-<id>) stored with the guest so a deleted guest's room is unreachable and nickname reuse never inherits history; the owner's Guest view lists current guests' rooms from the guest store; (2) approved users' sandbox nick becomes sbx-op-<local> and guest nicknames may not contain '-', so a guest can never take an approved user's nick or room; (3) idle guest sandbox sessions close after guest_mode.idle_close_s (default 600 s) with no open event stream, and sbx-ask parts guest rooms that have emptied; (4) the real-mesh 'No room' empty state gets a next-step hint (h58) and the owner metrics agent state uses room membership
deviations.reason: owner confirmed the triage recommendation 2026-10-09: deletion is a Privacy Policy promise; nick/room collision lets a guest share or impersonate the owner; sessions never closed so the active-guest gauge only grows; h58 is a confirmed honesty condition

deviations.what: Amends d7's deletion fix after staging showed AgentIRC commits history only at shutdown (an external purge cannot see or remove live rows and would block on the IRCd's write transaction): the sandbox IRCd runs memory-only (culture server --no-persist, no history/rooms on disk); the lens records each sbx-ask answer in the guest store beside the guest's question (linked, erased by deletion); on deletion the guest's Q&A pairs are first copied, PII-scrubbed and stripped of email/IP/nick/room, with a random id and day-only date, NSFW-declined pairs dropped, into a separate corpus table that deletion keeps; the lens no longer purges IRCd history (flag-log purge stays); the Privacy Policy gains a sentence that anonymized Q&A that cannot reasonably identify the guest may be kept after deletion (owner reviews wording, r3)
deviations.reason: owner decision 2026-10-09: memory-only + store answers + keep in DB anonymized Q&A that can't reasonably be linked to or identify a user

agent online/offline means the agent is in this session's room now, re-read with WHO on every 15 s poll (was: spoke within 60 s)

Sandbox sessions with no open tab close after guest_mode.idle_close_s (SSE keepalive every 15 s detects closed tabs); sbx-ask leaves guest rooms that emptied

The sandbox IRCd runs memory-only (--no-persist); the guest store holds each guest's questions and sbx-ask's answers; deletion keeps an anonymized Q&A corpus (no email/IP/nick/room, PII-scrubbed, day-only, NSFW pairs dropped) and erases everything linked, plus the guest's flag-log lines
